<a id="page-events"></a>
# Events and actions

Every event (trigger) a line can react to, with its fields, and every action, with its fields and its verb. Open
it when a UI reacts to more than a tap and a change, or an action needs a field the verbs do not say.

<a id="events-an-event"></a>
## An event

`on<Event>={actions}` on any line. The event is the trigger's name with `on` and a capital (`onLongPress`,
`onDragEnd`), except the notation's own names: `onTap` (click), `onChange` (changed), `onRightClick`, `onHover`
(cursorEnter), `onHoverMove` (hover), `onFocus`, `onBlur`, `onSubmit`. A trigger's fields go in parentheses,
by name, `,` between them. `result` in the actions is what the event carries (its doc says what).

```notation
Column w=40 h=40 onKeyDown(key=Enter)={emit go} onEnterViewport(visibleFraction=0.5)={emit seen}
```

The screen's timers and keys are lines of their own after the tree: `every 1s onTick={…}` (a `timer`),
`key mod+k onPress={…}` (a `keyDown` of the screen); `when cond` after the interval or key runs it only while
`cond` holds. Any other reaction of the screen is an `on` line: `on`, the trigger's name, its fields in
parentheses, `=` and the actions: `on load={…}` when the screen opens, `on backPressed={…}` for the system's back,
`on valueChanged(variable=draft)={…}` when a variable changes.

```notation
state step=0
state saved=[]
Text "Step {step}"
every 1s onTick={step=step+1}
key mod+k onPress={step=0}
on load={saved=coalesce(storage.saved, [])}
on backPressed(when={step > 0})={step=step-1}
on valueChanged(variable=step)={saved=append(saved,step)}
```

<a id="events-trigger-fields"></a>
### Trigger fields

Every trigger takes these fields (each one's doc says which triggers read it):

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `debounceMs` | whole number | `0` | Waits this long after the last trigger before running, so a burst (typing in a search field) runs once. 0 runs every time. |
| `variable` | text | `""` | `TriggerType.valueChanged`: the variable watched. |
| `intervalMs` | whole number | `1000` | Timer: ms between ticks (a number or an expression). |
| `key` | text | `""` | Key triggers: the key or combination (`KeyCombo`); empty: any key. |
| `when` | text | `""` | A formula; the reaction runs only while it's true (key triggers take the key only then; a timer or a frame ticker runs only then). Empty: always. |
| `holdMs` | whole number | `1200` | hold, and longPress when set (else the platform's 500 ms): how long the press is held (ms). |
| `visibleFraction` | number | `0.15` | Viewport triggers: the visible share (0–1) that counts as in view. |
| `repeat` | `true`/`false` | `false` | keyDown: also while the key repeats. |
| `visibleMs` | whole number (≥ 0) | `0` | Viewport: how long it stays in view before firing (ms). |
| `onceKey` | text | `""` | Runs once per key (an expression, such as ${item.id}) per app session. |
| `event` | text | `""` | event: the key of the component event it handles (one of the component's widget.events). |
| `commitMs` | whole number (≥ 0) | `0` | longPress and hold: from this many ms the press is the node's (letting go, moving or a scroll no longer cancels it; it still fires at holdMs). 0: none. |
| `haptic` | `selection` `light` `medium` `heavy` `vibrate` |  | A pointer trigger's buzz as the gesture becomes sure: at commitMs when set, else as it fires. |
| `focused` | `true`/`false` | `false` | keyDown and keyUp: only while the node, or a control inside it, has the keyboard focus (a control of one's own: a wheel's arrows), not whatever has the focus. |

### Events

| Event | Trigger | Level | Fires |
|---|---|---|---|
| <a id="trigger-click"></a>`onTap` | `click` | 0 | A tap (a click with a mouse). `${result}` holds where it landed (`x`, `y` in the node, `globalX`, `globalY`) and the modifier keys held (`meta`, `shift`, `alt`). |
| <a id="trigger-doubleTap"></a>`onDoubleTap` | `doubleTap` | 2 | Two taps in quick succession. A node with double tap reactions waits out the double tap timeout before its single taps run. |
| <a id="trigger-longPress"></a>`onLongPress` | `longPress` | 2 | A long press: the platform's (500 ms), or held for `Trigger.holdMs` when it is set; `Trigger.commitMs` and `Trigger.haptic` as for hold. |

| <a id="trigger-swipeRight"></a>`onSwipeRight` | `swipeRight` | 4 |  |

| <a id="trigger-changeStart"></a>`onChangeStart` | `changeStart` | 1 | A slider was taken (a drag or a press on it began, or a key moves it), with its value before the change (Flutter's `onChangeStart`). |

Cached images can report loaded immediately without a loading event. |
| <a id="trigger-imageLoaded"></a>`onImageLoaded` | `imageLoaded` | 2 |  |

While `blockBack` is false, back leaves as usual and this doesn't fire. |

A frame that comes while the chain still runs is skipped; its time goes to the next `dt`. A design canvas never ticks. |
| <a id="trigger-keyDown"></a>`onKeyDown` | `keyDown` | 4 | A key went down (or up) while the screen shows; `Trigger.key` limits it to one key or combination, `Trigger.when` to while a formula holds. `${result.key}`, `${result.shift}`, `${result.alt}`, `${result.meta}`. |
| <a id="trigger-keyUp"></a>`onKeyUp` | `keyUp` | 4 |  |
| <a id="trigger-scroll"></a>`onScroll` | `scroll` | 4 | The node (a scrolling row, column, list, grid or canvas) scrolled (`${result.offset}`, `${result.max}`, `${result.fraction}` 0–1, `${result.index}` the item at the start of the view (the last at the end), `${result.count}` the items, `${result.overscroll}` how far it is pulled past an end: below 0 past the start, above 0 past the end, 0 within). Store what a carousel's arrows, dots or progress bar show. How near the end it is, to load more: `${result.max - result.offset}` (under 600: fetch the next page); a list's `pagination` loads its next page by itself (`thresholdPixels`). |
| <a id="trigger-scrollEnd"></a>`onScrollEnd` | `scrollEnd` | 4 | The node stopped scrolling; `${result}` as for `scroll`. |
| <a id="trigger-enterViewport"></a>`onEnterViewport` | `enterViewport` | 4 | At least `Trigger.visibleFraction` of the node became visible (and stayed so for `Trigger.visibleMs`), or it fell below that after being visible. With `Trigger.onceKey` (`${item.id}`), an impression: once per item per app session. |
| <a id="trigger-exitViewport"></a>`onExitViewport` | `exitViewport` | 4 |  |
| <a id="trigger-dragStart"></a>`onDragStart` | `dragStart` | 4 | Drag and drop: on a draggable (start, cancel, completed) and on a drop target (drop, enter, exit, rejected). `${result}` and `${drag}` hold the drag (what was dragged is `${result.data}`). A list with a `reorder` fires `dragStart` when a row is picked up and `dragCompleted` when it is let go (moved or not), with `${result.index}` and `${result.item}`: a list can change while a row is lifted (fold its rows into tiles). On a node with a `drag` reaction (and no drag and drop), `dragStart` is the start of that one-finger drag, where the finger went down (`${drag.x}`, `${drag.y}`): begin a stroke there rather than on `pointerDown`, which fires for every finger of a pinch. |
| <a id="trigger-dragCancel"></a>`onDragCancel` | `dragCancel` | 4 |  |
| <a id="trigger-dragCompleted"></a>`onDragCompleted` | `dragCompleted` | 4 |  |
| <a id="trigger-drop"></a>`onDrop` | `drop` | 4 |  |
| <a id="trigger-dragEnter"></a>`onDragEnter` | `dragEnter` | 4 |  |
| <a id="trigger-dragExit"></a>`onDragExit` | `dragExit` | 4 |  |
| <a id="trigger-dropRejected"></a>`onDropRejected` | `dropRejected` | 4 |  |
| <a id="trigger-reorder"></a>`onReorder` | `reorder` | 4 | A data list row was dragged to a new place by this node, its reorder handle (`${result.from}`, `${result.to}`). A list with a `reorder` fires it too, with `${result.item}`, `${result.fromList}`, `${result.toList}`. |
| <a id="trigger-refresh"></a>`onRefresh` | `refresh` | 2 | A list or grid was pulled past its start to refresh (its `pullToRefresh`, or its pagination's); its pagination reloads its first page too. A list with this reaction can always be pulled. |
| <a id="trigger-swipeAction"></a>`onSwipeAction` | `swipeAction` | 4 | A swipe action of a list item ran (the list's `swipeActions`): `${result.action}`, `${result.label}`, `${result.item}`, `${result.index}`. |
| <a id="trigger-rowTap"></a>`onRowTap` | `rowTap` | 1 | A table view's body row was tapped: `${result.row}` (the row's data), `${result.rowIndex}`, `${result.column}` (the tapped column's key), `${result.columnIndex}`. |
| <a id="trigger-sort"></a>`onSort` | `sort` | 1 | A table header was activated by pointer or keyboard: `${result.column}` is its key, `${result.columnIndex}` its index, and `${result.ascending}` the new direction. |
| <a id="trigger-linkTap"></a>`onLinkTap` | `linkTap` | 0 | A link in a text was tapped: a run of its `runs` with a `link` (`TextRun.link`). `${result.link}` is the run's link, `${result.text}` its characters, `${result.start}` and `${result.end}` where they are in the text. Without this reaction the tap opens the link (a web page, `mailto:`, `tel:`, an app link), as `openLink` does; with it, its actions run instead (a run whose link names something of the app's own: `link="restart"`). |
| <a id="trigger-actionError"></a>`onActionError` | `actionError` | 2 | On the current canvas: a failed action chain or cloud subscription. `${result.error}` is `{type, message, action, nodeId}` (no stack or raw service objects). A failure in this reaction reports to the host without recursively firing another actionError reaction. |
| <a id="trigger-event"></a>`onEvent` | `event` | 3 | On a component call: the component fired its event `Trigger.event` (a `componentEvent` action inside its definition); `${result}` is the event's payload. Flutter: the callback passed to a widget's `onChanged`-style parameter. The handler runs in the caller's scope. |

<a id="events-actions"></a>
## Actions

Actions are separated by `;`. A verb says a common action in a word; any action is its type and its fields by
name, each value as on a line (a number, a word, `"text"` in which `{x}` reads a value, `{expression}`, JSON).
A field that holds actions takes them in braces: `confirm "Remove it?" then {close}`, `onError={toast "Failed"}`.
`cond ? a : b` chooses between actions (a branch may be `{a; b}`, or empty; `cond ? a` alone does nothing when it
does not hold). `if` is a line of the tree, not a verb: `onTap={missing ? {open naming} : {open account}}`, not
`onTap={if missing {…} else {…}}` (the action by its type is `if condition={missing} then={…} else={…}`). A verb
says only the fields its row shows; any other is the action by its type: `showToast message="Saved" style=success`
(`toast "Saved" style=success` is said with that line). A number of an action is a number: `delay ms={…}` is the
delay's `duration={…}`, and a value worked out given to another number field is said. `close` closes the overlay the action
runs in; a second `close` in the same chain closes the one under it (`close; close` from a dialog over a dialog
closes both).

An expression is written the same everywhere: braces around it are the expression's (`when {length(sel) > 0}` is
`when length(sel) > 0`, `n={n + 1}` in an action is `n=n + 1`), and a map is a literal with keys (`m={a: 1}`, `{}`).
Inside a JSON value (`params={"id":"${msg.id}"}`) a value is written `${…}`: the `{x}` of a text does not reach
into JSON.

`confirm` takes the question, then a detail line, the buttons' words and `danger` before `then`: `confirm "Delete
it?" "It cannot be restored." ok="Delete" cancel="Keep" danger then {…} else {…}`; the action's own field names
read there too (`title="…"`, `message="…"`, `confirmLabel="…"`, `cancelLabel="…"`, `destructive=true`).

A click's `result` holds `x`, `y`, `globalX`, `globalY` and the keys held: `shift`, `alt`, `meta` (Control or
Command, the platform's "add to" key), `ctrl` (Control). A drag's (every move) holds `dx`, `dy` (the move since the
last event), `x`, `y`, `globalX`, `globalY`, `startX`, `startY`, `pointerCount`; a drag's end holds `vx`, `vy` (the
speed). `x`, `y`, `startX` and `startY` are in the node where it is now, `globalX` and `globalY` on the screen: a
node that moves with the pointer (a drawer pulled open) keeps `x` near `startX`, and how far it has been dragged is
each move's `dx` added up (`onDrag={pull=pull + result.dx}`). A text field's change is the text itself (`result`, not `result.text`). A press that reads the keys held
(a list whose rows are chosen this way needs none of it: `selectable`,
[lists.md](lists.md#lists-a-list-chosen-from-and-swiped)):

```notation
state rows=[{"id":"a","name":"Ada"},{"id":"b","name":"Lin"}]
state chosen=[]
Column gap=8
  each item in rows
    Text "{item.name}" onTap={result.meta ? chosen=append(chosen,item.id) : chosen=[item.id]}
    Text "Open" onTap={result.shift ? emit openBeside : emit open}
```

| Write | Action |
|---|---|
| `count=count+1` | [`setVariable`](#action-setVariable) |
| `emit save` | [`componentEvent`](#action-componentEvent) |
| `toast "Saved"` | [`showToast`](#action-showToast) |
| `open signup` | [`openModal`](#action-openModal) |
| `close` | [`closeModal`](#action-closeModal) |
| `go home` | [`navigate`](#action-navigate) |
| `scroll pricing` | [`scrollTo`](#action-scrollTo) |
| `link https://example.com` | [`openLink`](#action-openLink) |
| `announce "3 results"` | [`announce`](#action-announce) |
| `confirm "Remove it?" then {close}` | [`confirm`](#action-confirm) |
| `focus email` | [`focus`](#action-focus) |
| `blur` | [`focus`](#action-focus) |
| `copy "{link}"` | [`copyToClipboard`](#action-copyToClipboard) then [`showToast`](#action-showToast) |
| `ok ? close : toast "Fill it in"` | [`if`](#action-if) |

```notation
Column w=40 h=40 onTap={animate node=hero command=forward; scrollTo node=faq alignment=0}
```

<a id="events-fields-every-action-takes"></a>
### Fields every action takes

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true`/`false` | `true` | False skips the action. |
| `nonBlocking` | `true`/`false` | `false` | The chain doesn't wait for it, and its failure doesn't stop the chain. |
| `when` | JSON |  | Runs only when it holds. |

Fields that hold actions: `then`, `else`, `actions`, `onSuccess`, `onError`, `cancelActions`.

<a id="events-every-action"></a>
### Every action

<a id="action-navigate"></a>
### `navigate`: Navigate

Goes to another screen. JSON: `{"type": "navigate", "mode": "push", "to": "canvas-b", "params": {"id": "${item.id}"}}`. The destination reads `params` as `${route.<name>}`.

Written `navigate mode=… to=…`; the verb: `go home`. Level 2.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `push` `pop` `replace` `reset` | `push` |  |
| `to` | text | `""` | A screen (canvas) or layout id. |
| `params` | JSON |  | Values the destination reads as ${route.<name>}. |
| `base` | text | `""` | `NavigationMode.reset`: a screen to put under the destination, so going back from it lands there. |
| `baseParams` | JSON |  |  |
| `transition` | `platform` `none` `fade` `fadeUp` `slideUp` `slideLeft` `scale` | `platform` |  |
| `transitionMs` | whole number |  |  |
| `reverseTransitionMs` | whole number |  |  |
| `routeTransition` | [RouteTransition](navigation.md#type-RouteTransition) |  | A custom transition; replaces transition and its times. |

<a id="action-openModal"></a>
### `openModal`: Open modal

Shows a screen (canvas) as a modal: a dialog, a sheet, a popover. The `CloseModalAction` that closes it gives the chain that opened it its `${result}`. JSON: `{"type": "openModal", "to": "canvas-d", "presentation": "bottomSheet"}`.

Written `openModal to=… params=…`; the verb: `open signup`. Level 1.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `to` | text | `""` | The screen (canvas) shown. |
| `params` | JSON |  | Values the modal reads as ${route.<name>}. |
| `presentation` | `dialog` `bottomSheet` `adaptive` `sideSheet` `fullScreen` `popover` `banner` | `dialog` |  |
| `barrierDismissible` | `true`/`false` | `true` |  |
| `barrierColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) |  | Null: the default scrim. |
| `barrierBlur` | number | `0` |  |
| `showDragHandle` | `true`/`false` | `false` |  |
| `alignment` | list of number | `[0,0]` | A dialog's alignment, [x, y] (-1 to 1). |
| `anchor` | `none` `trigger` `pointer` `node` | `none` |  |
| `placement` | [PopoverPlacement](values.md#enum-PopoverPlacement) | `belowStart` |  |
| `anchorGap` | number | `4` |  |
| `anchorOffset` | number | `0` |  |
| `anchorReserve` | number | `0` | Room a popover keeps below its top: when its top plus this would pass the screen's bottom margin, it moves up to fit it (a menu keeps its place as it grows). 0: by its own height. |
| `popoverArrow` | `true`/`false` | `false` | Draw an arrow from an anchored popover toward its trigger. |
| `hoverCard` | `true`/`false` | `false` | Open as an interactive pointer-pass-through hover preview. |
| `hoverDelayMs` | whole number | `0` | Milliseconds of rest before showing the preview. |
| `anchorNode` | text | `""` | Anchor "node": the node the popover sits by (an id; may be an expression). |
| `anchorItem` | text | `""` | Anchor "node", for a node a list repeats: the item whose copy it sits by (its id or key, or its index). |
| `insets` | list of number | `[0,0,0,0]` | Space kept around a dialog: left, top, right, bottom. |
| `sheetWidth` | number |  |  |
| `sheetRadius` | number |  | A bottom sheet's top corner radius; the sheet clips the screen to it (null: the default). |
| `sheetBelow` | text | `""` | Adaptive: a bottom sheet on breakpoints narrower than this one (a breakpoint id; empty: the second). |
| `maxHeightFactor` | number | `1` |  |
| `snapHeights` | list of number | `[]` | Bottom sheet height stops as increasing fractions of available height, e.g. [0.5, 0.9]. |
| `stopVariable` | text | `""` | The name of a variable: the stop of snapHeights the open sheet rests at (0.5, 1), read and written. The sheet writes it as it opens and when it is moved to another stop; setting it moves the open sheet to the nearest stop; a sheet opened while it holds one of the stops opens there. 0 while the sheet is closed. |
| `cover` | `true`/`false` | `false` | A dialog that covers the screen: its screen fills it at the device size (its breakpoint follows the device). |
| `enterScale` | number | `1` | How large it starts (0–1), growing to its size as it comes in: a dialog about its middle, an anchored popover about the middle of the node that opened it (a menu that grows out of its button). 1: as the presentation comes. |
| `closeAfterMs` | whole number | `0` | Closes itself (no result) this many ms after it has come in; the clock holds while it is pressed or dragged. 0: stays until closed. |
| `routeTransition` | [RouteTransition](navigation.md#type-RouteTransition) |  | A custom transition: entrance, the screen behind, barrier, drag to dismiss. |

<a id="action-closeModal"></a>
### `closeModal`: Close modal

Closes the modal it runs in, giving the chain that opened it `result` (its text values are expressions) as `${result}`.

Written `closeModal result=…`; the verb: `close`. Level 1.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `result` | JSON |  | What the opening chain reads as ${result}; text values are expressions. |

<a id="action-retryFailed"></a>
### `retryFailed`: Retry failed actions

In an actionError reaction: runs the failed action chain again.

Written `retryFailed`. Level 2.

_No fields._

<a id="action-openLink"></a>
### `openLink`: Open link

Opens a URL (a web page, `mailto:`, `tel:`, an app link).

Written `openLink url=…`; the verb: `link https://example.com`. Level 0.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | text | `""` | A web page, mailto:, tel: or app link. |

<a id="action-setValue"></a>
### `setValue`: Set value

Sets properties of node `node` at runtime (until the screen goes). A property bound to a variable sets the variable instead.

Written `setValue node=… values=…`. Level 2.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `node` | text | `""` |  |
| `values` | JSON |  | The properties set: [{"path", "value" \| "mode"}]. |

<a id="action-setVariant"></a>
### `setVariant`: Set variant

Shows variant `variant` of variance node `node`.

Written `setVariant node=… variant=…`. Level 3.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `node` | text | `""` | A variance node. |
| `variant` | text | `""` | The variant's id (an expression). |

<a id="action-setVariable"></a>
### `setVariable`: Set variable

Changes variable `variable` (of the screen, or the app): `write`. JSON: `{"type": "setVariable", "variable": "count", "op": "add", "value": "1"}`. A computed variable can't be set. To glide a number to a new value, `AnimateAction` it (`animateTo`).

Written `setVariable variable=… op=…`; the verb: `count=count+1`. Level 2.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `variable` | text | `""` | The variable's name; a path into it sets that part. |
| `op` | [WriteOp](values.md#enum-WriteOp) | `set` | How the value changes. |
| `value` | text | `""` | The value (an expression); not for toggle, removeAt. |
| `index` | text | `""` | A list index (an expression). |
| `mapKey` | text | `""` | A map key (an expression). |

<a id="action-callFunction"></a>
### `callFunction`: Call function

Calls a function the app registered by `name` with `params` (text values are expressions). Its result is the chain's `${result}`: what the app's code answered (a permission granted, a share completed), which the next actions branch on. A function the app didn't register fails the chain, unless the action is `optional`.

Written `callFunction name=… params=…`. Level 2.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | text | `""` | The function the app registered. |
| `params` | JSON |  | Its arguments; text values are expressions. |
| `optional` | `true`/`false` | `false` | A function the app didn't register is skipped (${result} is null) instead of failing the chain. |

<a id="action-if"></a>
### `if`: If

Runs `then` when `condition` holds, else `orElse`. JSON: `{"type": "if", "condition": {...}, "then": [...], "else": [...]}`.

Written `if condition=… then=…`; the verb: `ok ? close : toast "Fill it in"`. Level 2.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `condition` | JSON |  | A predicate; null never holds. |
| `then` | JSON |  | Nested actions: run when it holds. |
| `else` | JSON |  | Nested actions: run when it doesn't. |

<a id="action-forEach"></a>
### `forEach`: For each

Runs `actions` once per item of list `items` (a path or expression). Every action of a turn reads the item and its index as `${loop.item}` and `${loop.index}`; `${result.item}` and `${result.index}` hold them too, until an action of the turn gives a result of its own.

Written `forEach items=… actions=…`. Level 2.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` | text | `""` | A list (a path or expression). |
| `actions` | JSON |  | Nested actions: run per item (${loop.item}, ${loop.index}). |

<a id="action-announce"></a>
### `announce`: Announce

Reads a message through the accessibility service without showing UI or moving focus.

Written `announce message=…`; the verb: `announce "3 results"`. Level 1.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `message` | text | `""` | Text read by the screen reader without moving focus. Expressions are evaluated when run. |

<a id="action-showToast"></a>
### `showToast`: Show toast

Shows a short message (a snackbar). Its button (`actionLabel`) runs `actions` on the chain that showed it. Cosmetics beyond the fields below (colors, radius, shadows, text styles, offsets per breakpoint) are in `style`, JSON.

Written `showToast message=… title=…`; the verb: `toast "Saved"`. Level 1.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `message` | text | `""` | An expression. |
| `title` | text | `""` | Expressions. |
| `durationMs` | whole number | `2600` |  |
| `style` | `neutral` `info` `success` `warning` `error` | `neutral` |  |
| `position` | `bottom` `top` | `bottom` |  |
| `actionLabel` | text | `""` | Its button. |
| `actions` | JSON |  | Nested actions: run by its button. |
| `showClose` | `true`/`false` | `false` |  |
| `icon` | JSON |  | An icon glyph's JSON. |
| `look` | JSON |  | Cosmetics, JSON: colors, radius, border, shadows, padding, widths, text styles, offsets, alignment; the button's actionBackgroundColor, actionBorder, actionCornerRadius, actionShadows; iconShadows; rotation (degrees), enterCurve, enterOffset (a share of its height). |
| `variables` | JSON |  | Style values bound to expressions, by style key. |

<a id="action-confirm"></a>
### `confirm`: Confirm

Asks the user to confirm; runs `actions` when they do, `cancelActions` when they don't. With `dialog` (a screen id), that screen is the dialog and what its close modal action returns is `${result}`.

Written `confirm title=… message=…`; the verb: `confirm "Remove it?" then {close}`. Level 1.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | text | `""` | Expressions. |
| `message` | text | `""` | Expressions. |
| `caption` | text | `""` | Expressions. |
| `confirmLabel` | text | `"OK"` |  |
| `cancelLabel` | text | `"Cancel"` |  |
| `destructive` | `true`/`false` | `false` |  |
| `actions` | JSON |  | Nested actions: run when confirmed. |
| `cancelActions` | JSON |  | Nested actions: run when canceled. |
| `dialog` | text | `""` | A screen id to show as the dialog. |
| `params` | JSON |  |  |
| `presentation` | `dialog` `bottomSheet` `adaptive` `sideSheet` `fullScreen` `popover` `banner` | `dialog` |  |
| `placement` | [PopoverPlacement](values.md#enum-PopoverPlacement) | `belowStart` |  |
| `barrierDismissible` | `true`/`false` | `true` |  |
| `look` | JSON |  | Cosmetics, JSON: colors, radius, border, shadows, text styles, button radius/border/shadows; confirmBorder, cancelBorder, buttonHeight, expandButtons; icon, iconSize, iconColor, iconDiscColor, iconDiscSize, iconDiscBorder; centered, width, maxWidth, insets, padding. |
| `variables` | JSON |  | Style values bound to expressions, by style key. |

<a id="action-delay"></a>
### `delay`: Delay

Waits `ms` milliseconds, or `duration` (a formula giving them) when that gives a number.

Written `delay ms=… duration=…`. Level 2.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ms` | whole number | `500` | A fixed wait, a whole number of milliseconds (`delay ms=300`). A wait worked out is `duration`. |
| `duration` | text | `""` | A formula giving milliseconds: `delay duration={fast ? 300 : 800}`. |

<a id="action-copyToClipboard"></a>
### `copyToClipboard`: Copy to clipboard

Copies `text` (an expression) to the clipboard.

Written `copyToClipboard text=…`. Level 1.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | text | `""` | An expression. |

<a id="action-setThemeMode"></a>
### `setThemeMode`: Set theme mode

Sets the site's theme mode (Flutter's ThemeMode: system, light or dark), as an app sets MaterialApp.themeMode: every screen redraws its named colors, text styles and controls in it; with persist (the default) the choice survives a reload. JSON: {"type": "setThemeMode", "mode": "${= theme.isDark ? 'light' : 'dark'}"}.

Written `setThemeMode mode=… persist=…`. Level 3.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | text | `"system"` | system (the device's setting), light or dark (Flutter's ThemeMode); an expression: "${= theme.isDark ? 'light' : 'dark'}" toggles. |
| `persist` | `true`/`false` | `true` | Keep the choice in the site's local storage: a reload (and every page) starts in it. |

<a id="action-editText"></a>
### `editText`: Edit text

Edits text field `node`'s text at its cursor: wraps the selection in `before` / `after`, toggles a (numbered) list, inserts or sets `text`, replaces the word being typed, clears it or focuses it.

Written `editText node=… operation=…`. Level 1.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `node` | text | `""` | A text field. |
| `operation` | `wrap` `toggleList` `insert` `replaceWord` `setText` `clear` `focus` | `insert` |  |
| `text` | text | `""` |  |
| `before` | text | `""` |  |
| `after` | text |  | Null: the same as before. |
| `numbered` | `true`/`false` | `false` |  |

<a id="action-focus"></a>
### `focus`: Focus

Focuses text field `node` (selecting its text with `selectAll`), or takes the focus away (`unfocus`; from every field when `node` is empty).

Written `focus node=… unfocus=…`; the verb: `focus email`, `blur`. Level 1.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `node` | text | `""` | A text field; empty with unfocus: every field. |
| `unfocus` | `true`/`false` | `false` |  |
| `selectAll` | `true`/`false` | `false` |  |

<a id="action-validate"></a>
### `validate`: Validate form

Flutter's FormState.validate(): every field of the form shows its validator's error; the first invalid one takes the focus. ${result}: whether all are valid.

Written `validate node=… focusFirstError=…`. Level 1.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `node` | text | `""` | The form (a node with a form behavior); empty: the form around the node running it, else the screen. |
| `focusFirstError` | `true`/`false` | `true` | Moves the focus to the first field that shows an error. |

<a id="action-controlTrack"></a>
### `controlTrack`: Control track

Turns the `Track` of node `node` (several ids: comma-separated, the first on screen takes it).

Written `controlTrack node=… command=…`. Level 4.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `node` | text | `""` | A node with a track. |
| `command` | `step` `animateTo` | `step` |  |
| `steps` | text | `"1"` | Step: how many steps (an expression). |
| `value` | text | `""` | animateTo: the value (an expression). |

<a id="action-controlDismissible"></a>
### `controlDismissible`: Control dismissible

Dismisses, brings back or resets node `node` (several ids: comma-separated).

Written `controlDismissible node=… command=…`. Level 4.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `node` | text | `""` | A dismissible (or pan) node. |
| `command` | `dismiss` `returnFrom` `reset` `shake` | `dismiss` |  |
| `direction` | `left` `right` `up` `down` | `right` |  |

<a id="action-controlTransform"></a>
### `controlTransform`: Control transform

Resets, zooms or poses the transform gesture of node `node`.

Written `controlTransform node=… command=…`. Level 4.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `node` | text | `""` | A node with a transform gesture. |
| `command` | `reset` `scaleBy` `animateTo` | `reset` |  |
| `value` | text | `""` | scaleBy: the factor (1.5 in, 0.67 out). animateTo: {x, y, scale, rotation} (an expression). |

<a id="action-scrollTo"></a>
### `scrollTo`: Scroll to

Scrolls node `node` into view: `alignment` 0 puts it at the start of the view, 1 at the end; `offset` moves it further. `axis` limits it to the scroll views along one axis (a map in a sideways window centers a point without scrolling the page under it); null scrolls every one around it.

Written `scrollTo node=… item=…`; the verb: `scroll pricing`. Level 2.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `node` | text | `""` | The node to reveal: its id, or an expression giving one (`"cmp-col-${cmpCol + 1}"`). A node that is not on screen when the action runs is reported as an action error, not skipped silently. |
| `item` | text | `""` | For a repeated node: the key (or index) of the list item whose copy to reveal. |
| `durationMs` | whole number | `400` |  |
| `curve` | text | `"easeInOut"` | A Curves name. |
| `alignment` | number | `0` | 0: at the start of the view, 1: at the end. |
| `offset` | number | `0` | Pixels the view stops short of the node: `offset=16` leaves 16 before it (the view scrolls 16 less), a negative offset scrolls past it. The view never scrolls past its start or its end. |
| `axis` | `horizontal` `vertical` |  | Only the scroll views along this axis; null: every one. |

<a id="action-animate"></a>
### `animate`: Animate

Drives an animation (Flutter's `AnimationController` methods): node `node`'s `animation` (`NodeAnimation`), or the number variable `variable` (an unbounded controller the screen keeps for it). JSON: `{"type": "animate", "node": "card", "animation": "pop", "command": "forward", "from": "0"}`, `{"type": "animate", "variable": "shownTotal", "command": "animateTo", "target": "${total}", "duration": "800", "curve": "easeOutCubic"}`. The chain waits for it to end (`TickerFuture`) unless it's `nonBlocking`; a repeat ends when its count does.

Written `animate node=… animation=…`. Level 4.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `node` | text | `""` | A node id or key; empty: the reacting node. |
| `animation` | text | `""` | The animation's id on the node. |
| `variable` | text | `""` | Instead of a node: a number variable. |
| `command` | [AnimateCommand](values.md#enum-AnimateCommand) | `forward` |  |
| `from` | text | `""` | Where forward/reverse start (an expression). |
| `target` | text | `""` | animateTo, animateBack, set (an expression). |
| `duration` | text | `""` | Milliseconds (an expression); empty: the animation's. |
| `curve` | [AnimationCurve](values.md#enum-AnimationCurve) |  | Null: the animation's (linear for a variable). |
| `spring` | [Spring](values.md#type-Spring) |  | `animateWith(SpringSimulation)` toward `target` instead of a duration. |

<a id="action-haptic"></a>
### `haptic`: Haptic feedback

Buzzes the device (`HapticFeedback`, on phones that support it; nothing elsewhere). Its common `when` buzzes only while a setting holds.

Written `haptic kind=…`. Level 4.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `selection` `light` `medium` `heavy` `vibrate` | `selection` |  |

<a id="action-runScript"></a>
### `runScript`: Run script

Runs script `script` (a layout's `scripts`, by id) with `arguments` (by parameter name; expressions: one `${...}` passes its value as is, other text passes as JSON when it is JSON, else as text). Its result is the chain's `${result}` (and goes in `resultVariable` when set). When it fails, `onError` runs with `${result}` `{error: {type, message, line, column}, logs}`; without `onError` a failure stops the chain.

Written `runScript script=… arguments=…`. Level 4.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `script` | text | `""` | A script of the layout's scripts. |
| `arguments` | JSON |  | By parameter name (expressions). |
| `resultVariable` | text | `""` | Gets the result. |
| `onError` | JSON |  | Nested actions: run when it fails (${result.error}, ${result.logs}). |

<a id="action-paginate"></a>
### `paginate`: Paginate

Moves the pagination controller of a list or grid (its `pagination`, by `controller`, the pagination's name).

Written `paginate controller=… command=…`. Level 2.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `controller` | text | `""` | The pagination's name. |
| `command` | `next` `previous` `goTo` `first` `last` `refresh` `retry` `setPageSize` | `next` |  |
| `page` | text | `"1"` | For goTo: a number or an expression. |
| `pageSize` | text | `"20"` | For setPageSize. |

<a id="action-componentEvent"></a>
### `componentEvent`: Fire component event

Inside a component: fires one of its declared events; the call's event reactions run with the value as ${result}.

Written `componentEvent event=… value=…`; the verb: `emit save`. Level 0.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `event` | text | `""` | The key of the event, one of the component's widget.events. |
| `value` | JSON |  | The payload (`${result}` in the call's handler): JSON whose strings are expressions. |
